about: Config for reply-checker.mjs. Applies to every BRP agent that talks to people (today: soldier_liaison, disabled). Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against one sentence at a time.
model_reason: A cheaper model than the agent's own is fine for a second read, but this check guards safety and honesty lines, so it uses Sonnet 5.5 rather than Haiku. The rules below run first and win over the model when they disagree.
fallback_reply: I will confirm that with the program manager and come back to you.

capability.label: States what another person, office, line or system can do, when, or how fast
patterns: \b(any ?time|24/7|24 hours a day|around the clock|right away for you)\b

\b(crisis line|hotline|admin console|console|housing office|legal assistance|claims office|chain of command|staff duty|cq|vendor|site lead|program manager|barracks manager|technician|tech)\b[^.]*\b(can (help|see|show|fix|advise|tell|answer|change|approve)|will (help|call|fix|come|see|show)|is able to|are able to|handles|lets you|shows)\b

authority.label: States who decides or approves something

safety.label: Safety advice beyond the pack's script
patterns: \b(it is|it's|you're|you are|room is) (safe|fine|usable)\b(?<!say it's safe)(?<!say it is safe)
script: Get out of the room to fresh air now and call 911.
Do not go back in until responders or the barracks manager say it is safe.
Call or text the Veterans and Military Crisis Line: dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255.
If you are in danger now, call 911.

restore.line: Get out of the room to fresh air now and call 911. Do not go back in until responders or the barracks manager say it is safe.
Call or text the Veterans and Military Crisis Line: dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255. If you are in danger now, call 911.

action_claim.label: Says an action happened, or will happen, with no action record in the conversation
patterns: \bI(?:'ll| will|'m going to| am going to) (?:flag|escalate|page|send|log|notify|tell|pass|forward|open|cue|ask|book|order|let|report|alert|make sure)\b
action_claim.skip_if: ^(if|when|once|as soon as|after)\b|\?$|^(do you want|would you like|want me to|i can |shall i)
